description: This file defines an abstract class 'DashletGenericChart' for creating and managing dashboard chart components within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties and methods for configuration, rendering, auto-refresh, query construction, and data processing related to dashboard charts. It also handles lazy loading of seed beans and chart data retrieval.

classes.name: DashletGenericChart
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating customizable dashboard charts with configuration, auto-refresh, and data handling capabilities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the dashlet, loading configuration, language, and setting up the layout manager.

methods.name: setRefreshIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the refresh icon if the dashlet is refreshable.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for rendering the chart dashlet.

methods.name: getConfigureSmartyInstance
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Smarty instance used for configuration templates.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves configuration options submitted from the dashlet's configuration UI.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration popup for the dashlet, including search fields and refresh options.

methods.name: getSeedBean
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the seed bean object used within the dashlet.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Placeholder method to generate SQL query for data; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Placeholder method to generate group-by parameters for SQL queries; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the dashlet, including auto-refresh setup.

methods.name: processAutoRefresh
methods.description: Generates HTML/JavaScript code to enable auto-refresh of the dashlet.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Retrieves chart data from database using provided query.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Sorts and translates data set based on specified columns and translation flags.
